run universe tibet-mega-dam (2026-09-04): reviewed the existing mapping before amending anything, per DEPTH mode's own instruction to census only money-corner and UNDISCOVERED links to 5 issuers. The chain's current heat has zero money-corner links and zero UNDISCOVERED-verdict links (all 11 read QUIET, EMERGING, or CROWDED per the 2026-09-02 rescore), so the DEPTH in-scope set for this theme is empty. The mapping already exceeds even the BREADTH bar regardless: all 11 links carry either TARGET_MET (>=10 ACTIVE issuer placements: copper-conductors, uhvdc-transmission, hydro-turbines, global-hydro-spillover, tunneling-tbm, civil-construction, riparian-risk-monitoring) or a proved EXHAUSTED multi-source record (cement-materials 3 issuers/3 searches, yajiang-developer 0 issuers/5 searches, india-counter-buildout 1 issuer/3 searches, power-offtake 0 issuers/9 searches), so no link has zero placements and zero searches. Mapping status is COMPLETE with a PASS fresh-context audit dated 2026-08-30T13:32:53Z whose signed mapping_fingerprint (cb6fff35...) still matches current material content: I made no material edit, so I left status COMPLETE rather than reopening it without a FAIL audit, which method 6A reserves for a newer FAIL review over unchanged content. check_map.py returns OK across all 6 maps including this one. Conclusion: the premise that handed me this run ('no COMPLETE issuer mapping for this chain') does not match repository state; nothing needed amending, and I amended nothing.

ESCALATION for Ron, not auto-applied (found while reviewing tibet-mega-dam, tools/check_campaign.py is outside my lane to edit): _actual_theme_stage's DEPTH branch computes `scope = links_in_scope(chain, targets)` and then does `if not isinstance(mapping, dict) or not scope: return stage` before checking coverage. When a theme's chain has zero money-corner links and zero UNDISCOVERED-verdict links, scope is the empty set, and the empty check short-circuits the theme at SCENARIOS forever, no matter how complete its mapping actually is. tibet-mega-dam is exactly this case: mapping status COMPLETE, PASS audit, every one of 11 links TARGET_MET or EXHAUSTED, yet check_campaign.py and campaign_calibrate.py both leave the theme reading SCENARIOS because scope is falsy. An empty in-scope set should read as vacuously satisfied (there is nothing DEPTH owes this theme's map beyond what full coverage already gives it), not as not-yet-attempted. This is very likely what generated the 'no COMPLETE issuer mapping for this chain' premise that started this run: the dashboard reads the stuck stage, not the mapping file. Suggested fix for whoever touches tools/check_campaign.py next: treat `not scope` as MAPPED (vacuous truth) when `mapping.get('status') == 'COMPLETE'` or coverage is otherwise closed, rather than returning early.
